description: Scans live pages with the AudioEye rules engine and maps accessibility issues to JSX source.
name: com.audioeye/testing-sdk-mcp

environmentVariables.description: AudioEye testing-SDK license client id. Optional at startup; scans fail closed without it.
environmentVariables.name: AUDIOEYE_TESTING_SDK_CLIENT_ID

environmentVariables.description: AudioEye testing-SDK license client token. Optional at startup; scans fail closed without it.
environmentVariables.name: AUDIOEYE_TESTING_SDK_CLIENT_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Repo root for source-context tools and .audioeye-mcp.json discovery; defaults to the server's working directory.
environmentVariables.name: AUDIOEYE_MCP_WORKSPACE

title: AudioEye Accessibility Testing
